Author: ofnature
Name: Demeter
Punchline: Gathers and fishes what you ask for — node by node, list by list — for you or for another plugin.
Description: Unattended gathering for Miner and Botanist: travels to the zone, flies the node circuit, works collectables to the band asked for, and keeps named gather lists with target amounts. Fishing too: it goes to the hole, judges each bite by its timing and tug, moochs along the road to the fish and catches its predators first, and fishes Cosmic Exploration missions where it stands, spending GP on the fish worth the most. Other plugins (Hephaestus, Odysseus, Selene) ask it for items over IPC. Companion to Daedalus and Odysseus.
